headword: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}

definitions.gloss: turnaround point; halfway point; midway mark
definitions.explanation: The point at which one turns around and heads back, either literally (in a race or journey) or figuratively (the midpoint of a project, period, or process).

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I reached the turnaround point of the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: The project has finally passed the halfway point.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{給水所|きゅうすいじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられていた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: A hydration station was set up at the turnaround point.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返し：10628_orikaeshi⟧ (turning back) + ⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧ (point/location). The literal meaning is the point where you turn around and head back.

LITERAL USE:
Most commonly used in marathons and running races with out-and-back courses. Also applies to any journey or route with a turnaround point.

USAGE:
Widely used for the midpoint of a process, project, or time period:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}: the midpoint of life
- ⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}: the halfway mark of a project
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{折|お}り{返|かえ}し{地点|ちてん}だ: we're already halfway through the year

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{折|お}り{返|かえ}し→折り返し：10628_orikaeshi⟧: turnaround; also means "by return" (as in calling back)
- ⟦{中間|ちゅうかん}→中間：05458_chuukan⟧⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧: midpoint (more neutral, less vivid)
